findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_kol_leaderboard, chainlink_feed, get_stock_multipliers, pending_corporate_actions, agent_signal_digest · Private data: get_trending_tokens, get_token, get_token_candles, search_tokens, get_intel, get_narratives, check_token_risk, chainlink_feed, get_equity_flows, get_settlement_graph, pending_corporate_actions, stock_float, earn_tracker, chain_composition · Public sink: get_kol_leaderboard, get_equity_flows, get_stock_multipliers, pending_corporate_actions, stablecoin_flows, earn_tracker, chain_economics, chain_composition, agent_signal_digest.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_kol_leaderboard, chainlink_feed, get_stock_multipliers, pending_corporate_actions, agent_signal_digest · Private data: get_trending_tokens, get_token, get_token_candles, search_tokens, get_intel, get_narratives, check_token_risk, chainlink_feed, get_equity_flows, get_settlement_graph, pending_corporate_actions, stock_float, earn_tracker, chain_composition · Public sink: get_kol_leaderboard, get_equity_flows, get_stock_multipliers, pending_corporate_actions, stablecoin_flows, earn_tracker, chain_economics, chain_composition, agent_signal_digest

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
